reasons: The insertion is correctly placed as a new subsection (l) in the General Provisions immediately after p0159, leaving the existing text untouched — a minimal, additive edit appropriate for a 'missing' finding.

Inserted language tracks the playbook preferred position (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request) and correctly imposes the obligation on Licensor (counterparty), not on us.

Rationale supports the missing status: the only existing 'insurance' reference (p0051) is a cost pass-through to Licensee rather than a coverage covenant, and the hosted-technology/data-flow facts place Licensor within the rule's scope, justifying unconditional cyber coverage.
Comment is concise, first-person plural, prefixed correctly, accurately describes the change, cites the playbook limits and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback without lecturing.
Deterministic checks pass and no directional or drafting defects identified.
